description.text: Biology is a fundamental discipline of natural science that studies life phenomena and their laws, covering multi-level life systems from molecules, cells, tissues, organs to individuals, populations, communities and ecosystems. As a discipline that emphasizes both experimental and theoretical aspects, it not only explores the essence of life (such as genetic mechanisms and evolutionary laws), but also addresses practical issues such as human health, agricultural production, and ecological protection. Modern biology has been integrated with medicine, information technology, engineering and other fields, giving rise to emerging areas such as biomedical engineering, synthetic biology and bioinformatics. It is one of the core disciplines of natural science in the 21st century.

duration.text: The Biology at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

Original Physical Examination Record for Foreigners and original blood Test Report4.Original Certificate of no Criminal Record within the validity period5. Original and notarized copy of the highest academic degree certificate (required for fresh graduates)The official pre-graduation certificate issued by the school.6. Original and notarized transcripts of academic records from the undergraduate stage onwardsScanned copies of transcripts should include those for undergraduate, master's (if any), and doctoral (if any) degreesThere is the learning stage, up to the grades of the most recent semester. The transcript should be byIssued by the Academic Affairs Office, Graduate School or relevant student management department of the school attendedAnd affix the seal.7. Recommendation letterTwo letters, issued by a professor or associate professor. If the applicant has already contacted our school's supervisorThe applicant is requested to contact the supervisor to issue the "Xi 'an Jiaotong UniversityOne of the two recommendation letters is the "Recommendation Letter from the Supervisor of the International Student". 8. Study or research plan in ChinaApplicants are required to submit a study or research plan in China written in either Chinese or EnglishSwipe. A master's degree holder should write no less than 800 words, and a doctoral degree holder no less than 1,500 words. 9. Research achievementsPublished papers, award certificates, invention patents, etc. prove one's academic achievementsInformation on achievements and research capabilities. 10. Proof of language proficiency 11. Copy of a valid ordinary passportThe validity period of the passport should be later than September 2025 If it does not meet the requirements, please contact us promptlyA new passport will be issued when necessary

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens in good health;2. Degree and age requirementsApplicants to study for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 1835 years old;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than the required ageForty years old.3. Not other scholarship recipients
